before.sentence: Across 396 rows and 80 numeric columns, the rows differ from each other by orders of magnitude and the columns barely differ at all. In an assay table that is what features in rows looks like: different analytes have very different abundances, and samples of the same kind do not.

orientation.methods_sentence: The table was supplied with features in rows and samples in columns, and was transposed to one row per sample before any diagnosis was run; 396 measurements across 80 samples were read.
orientation.kept_sentence: The table was confirmed as one row per sample and was not transposed.
